title: Paper Radar 實測：三篇虛構摘要（分數未校準）
interest: Benchmarks for evaluating tool-using LLM agents

papers.title: ToolBench Mini: Evaluating Repeated Tool Calls
papers.abstract: We introduce a benchmark for LLM agents that must plan and execute sequences of tool calls. Tasks require retrieving information, checking intermediate results and recovering from a failed tool. We report completion rate and error recovery across several agent policies.
papers.reason: 直接命中：摘要提出評測 LLM agent 規劃與執行多步工具呼叫的 benchmark，含失敗工具復原，並報告完成率與錯誤復原指標。

papers.title: KV Compression for Long-Context Inference
papers.abstract: We compress the key-value cache used by a language model during long-context inference. Evaluation measures memory savings, latency and language-model quality. The method does not introduce a benchmark for tool-using agents.
papers.reason: 僅與 LLM 相關：主題是長上下文推論的 KV 快取壓縮，評估記憶體、延遲與模型品質；摘要明言未提出工具型 agent 的 benchmark。

papers.title: Tomato Leaf Image Classification with a Small Network
papers.abstract: We train a compact image classifier to identify tomato leaf diseases from photographs. The study compares classification accuracy and model size on a leaf-image dataset. It contains no language-model agent tasks.
papers.reason: 無關：番茄葉病害影像分類，摘要明言不含語言模型 agent 任務，也非 LLM 評測。
